lines.en: label thefirstclass:
scene newfirstday1
: Hey, so are you feeling any better today? Or are you just going to teach class with that whole “Where am I?” thing still going on?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你今天感觉好点了吗？还是说你打算带着那副“我在哪儿？”的德行去上课？

lines.en: : I feel pretty much the same, to be honest. I doubt I'd even know where I'm going without you.
lines.zh: : 说实话，感觉跟之前差不多。要是没有你，我怀疑自己连该往哪儿走都不知道。

lines.en: I also doubt that I'd be able to remember the names of all ten of my students if it weren't for that book the previous {i}me{/i} kept tucked away.
lines.zh: 我也怀疑，如果不是“之前的{i}我{/i}”偷偷藏着的那本书，我根本记不住十个学生的名字。

lines.en: Thankfully, I studied everyone's names and faces long enough last night that I {i}should{/i} be able to handle it.
lines.zh: 幸好昨晚我把每个人的名字和脸都背了够久，应{i}该{/i}能应付得来。

lines.en: scene newfirstday2
: Are you sure you're even going to be {i}able{/i} to teach? If you can't remember where the school is, I doubt you can remember any of your lesson plans and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你确定你还{i}能{/i}教课吗？如果你连学校在哪儿都记不住，我怀疑你更记不住教案什么的。

lines.en: : Oh, don't worry about that. I've come up with a foolproof new method of teaching that I'm sure everyone is going to be very excited about.
lines.zh: : 哦，这个不用担心。我想出了一个万无一失的新教学法，我敢肯定大家都会非常兴奋的。

lines.en: : A {i}new{/i} method? But-
lines.zh: : {i}新{/i}方法？可是——

lines.en: : Ami! Sensei! Good morning!
lines.zh: : Ami！老师！早上好！

lines.en: scene newfirstday3
: Wow. You're looking even more handsome than normal, Sensei. Did something change overnight? Or have I just fallen more in love with you for no reason whatsoever?
lines.zh: : 哇。你今天看起来比平时还帅，老师。是一夜之间变了什么吗？还是说我又毫无理由地更爱你了？

lines.en: : Sensei has amnesia...or something. Also, please don't touch my uncle this early in the morning.
lines.zh: : 老师失忆了……还是什么的。另外，别一大早就碰我叔叔。

lines.en: : Or ever.
lines.zh: : 或者说，永远都别碰。

lines.en: scene newfirstday4
: Amnesia?
lines.zh: : 失忆？

lines.en: : Or something.
lines.zh: : 还是什么的。

lines.en: : It's complicated.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: : So...do you not remember who I am anymore?
lines.zh: : 所以……你已经不记得我是谁了吗？

lines.en: : Of course I remember who you are, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我当然记得你是谁，Ayane。

lines.en: After all, how could I forget one of the faces I spent an ungodly amount of time studying last night in preparation for this exact sort of thing?
lines.zh: 毕竟，昨晚为了应付这种场面，我花了极其漫长的时间去记那些脸，怎么可能忘了其中一张？

lines.en: scene newfirstday5
: Oh, thank God. Because if you didn't, I would have nothing left to do but kill myself.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。因为你要是不记得了，我就只剩下自杀这一条路可走了。

lines.en: : Don’t you think that’s a bit of an overreaction, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得这反应过度了吗，Ayane？

lines.en: : Oh, stop it. You know you'd do the same exact thing, Ami. The two of us are comrades in arms. Just, in this case, the arms belong to a man twice our size and twice our age.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这么说。你知道你会做一模一样的事，Ami。我们俩是战友。只不过这一回，那双手属于一个身形和年纪都是我们两倍的男人。

lines.en: scene newfirstday6
: So, Sensei...since you have amnesia now, I suppose I should probably remind you about our date this weekend.
lines.zh: : 那么，老师……既然你现在失忆了，我想我大概得提醒你一下我们这周末的约会。

lines.en: : We’re going on a date?
lines.zh: : 我们要约会？

lines.en: : Like heck you are! Dating students is completely against rules! You have to be related to be able to spend time together like that!
lines.zh: : 想得美！和学生约会是彻底违反规定的！能那样共处的前提，是你们得有血缘关系！

lines.en: : Sensei will just adopt me then. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那老师收养我就行了。对吧，老师？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 没问题。

lines.en: scene newfirstday7
: No! Not sure! Where would she even sleep?!
lines.zh: : 不行！不许没问题！她到底要睡哪儿啊？！

lines.en: : Are you {i}sure{/i} you want an answer to that question, Ami? Because I'm not sure you'd like it.
lines.zh: : 你{i}确定{/i}想要这个问题的答案吗，Ami？因为我不确定你会喜欢。

lines.en: scene newfirstday8
: There shouldn't even {i}be{/i} a question because Sensei should know by now that I'm the only person allowed to live with him.
lines.zh: : 根本就{i}不该有{/i}这个问题，因为老师现在应该已经明白了，唯一被允许和他住在一起的人是我。

lines.en: : Am I allowed to blame this misstep on amnesia or will that not get me off the hook?
lines.zh: : 我能不能把这次失误推到失忆头上？还是说这样也脱不了身？

lines.en: : You can make it up to me by ignoring Ayane until we get to school.
lines.zh: : 想补偿我的话，就一直到学校都别理 Ayane。

lines.en: scene newfirstday9
: It's fine, Sensei. Just go along with it. I've already gotten used to unrequited love, so ignoring me for another fifteen minutes or so is nothing to me.
lines.zh: : 没关系，老师。顺着她就是了。我早就习惯单相思了，所以再被无视个十五分钟左右，对我来说算不上什么。

lines.en: : I'll make it up to you at our date this weekend.
lines.zh: : 这周末约会的时候我再补偿你。

lines.en: scene newfirstday10
: THERE WILL BE NO DATE!
lines.zh: : 根本就不会有什么约会！

lines.en: scene black
And so the three of us continued on toward the school as if nothing has changed at all...
lines.zh: 于是我们三个就这样继续朝学校走去，仿佛什么都没有变过……

lines.en: As if I'm the same person they walk this route with every day...
lines.zh: 仿佛我还是那个每天陪她们走这条路的人……

lines.en: Blissfully unaware of the images of them I conjured up in my mind as I pulled the sheets over my head last night and the things I proceeded to do to myself thereafter.
lines.zh: 她们毫不知情，不知道昨晚我把被子拉过头顶时，在脑海里勾勒出的那些画面，以及在那之后我对自己做的事。

lines.en: But that's fine.
lines.zh: 但没关系。

lines.en: Because soon, I'll be confident enough here to fully assume the role I've been given.
lines.zh: 因为很快，我就会在这里足够自信，彻底担起我被赋予的这个身份。

lines.en: I'll be confident enough to be who they think I am.
lines.zh: 我会自信到成为她们以为的那个人。

lines.en: And I'll be confident enough to act in stark contrast to that and become who I think they {i}need{/i} me to be and not what they want.
lines.zh: 我也会自信到反其道而行之，成为我认为她们{i}需要{/i}的人，而不是她们想要的人。

lines.en: In turn, I imagine they will do the same.
lines.zh: 反过来，我想她们也会如此。

lines.en: And I imagine these days where the bright sun shines down on my back will turn into days of melancholy.
lines.zh: 我想，这些明亮的阳光照在我背上的日子，终将变成忧郁的日子。

lines.en: And then to days of depravity.
lines.zh: 然后变成堕落的日子。

lines.en: To days of nothing but the feeling of flesh on flesh and the loneliness that accompanies the moments after aggressive ejaculation.
lines.zh: 变成只剩下肌肤相贴的触感，以及激烈射精之后随之而来的那种孤独的日子。

lines.en: But first and foremost-
lines.zh: 但首先——

lines.en: scene newfirstday11
I must assimilate.
lines.zh: 我必须融入。

lines.en: : Do your best today, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 老师，今天加油哦！

lines.en: : Come see me after class and I can take you to a janitor's closet where Ami won't be able to see us kiss each other.
lines.zh: : 下课后你来找我，我带你去一间 Ami 看不见的杂物间，我们就能在那儿接吻了。

lines.en: : Ugh...I don’t even care anymore.
lines.zh: : 呃……我已经连管都懒得管了。

lines.en: scene newfirstday12
The two of them disappear into the classroom and I take a moment to gather my thoughts and figure out how I'm going to approach this.
lines.zh: 她们俩消失在教室里，我花了一点时间整理思绪，盘算该怎么着手。

lines.en: Despite already having what I referred to earlier as a {i}foolproof{/i} strategy, I'm still surprisingly nervous.
lines.zh: 尽管我前面已经自称有了{i}万无一失{/i}的策略，我还是意外地紧张。

lines.en: Not because I'll be the center of attention, but because I am worried about how far the flames would spread in the event this backfires.
lines.zh: 不是因为我会成为众人的焦点，而是因为我担心万一弄巧成拙，火会烧出去多远。

lines.en: This is still a job, whether I decided to take it seriously or not.
lines.zh: 不管我有没有打算认真对待，这终究还是一份工作。

lines.en: It's my window to the new world I've found myself inside of. And it's one with a broken lock.
lines.zh: 它是我望向这个我误打误撞闯进来的新世界的窗口。而那扇窗的锁是坏的。

lines.en: If it closes, I have no idea how hard it will be to open it back up.
lines.zh: 如果它关上了，我不知道再把它撬开会有多难。

lines.en: And so I'll do all I can to keep it propped open at all costs.
lines.zh: 所以我会不惜一切代价让它一直撑开着。

lines.en: I don't want to look at life from the outside.
lines.zh: 我不想站在外面旁观人生。

lines.en: Not {i}this{/i} life, at least...
lines.zh: 至少，不想旁观{i}这{/i}一世……

lines.en: A light tap on my shoulder drags me away from another cynical monologue and back into reality.
lines.zh: 肩上轻轻一拍，把我从又一段愤世嫉俗的独白里拽回了现实。

lines.en: scene newfirstday13
: Good morning, Sensei! I have all of the handouts ready to go for today’s class.
lines.zh: : 老师早上好！今天上课要用的讲义我都准备好了。

lines.en: : I already put them on your desk, so you’re all set. I can hand them out too, if you want. I know how tired you can be in the mornings.
lines.zh: : 我已经放在您桌上了，您什么都不用操心。如果您愿意，我也可以帮您发下去。我知道您早上会很困。

lines.en: : Oh...uhh, thanks.
lines.zh: : 哦……呃，谢谢。

lines.en: : Is there anything else I can do for you before class starts? The library is empty right now, so if you need anything printed, now is the time.
lines.zh: : 上课前还有什么我能为您做的吗？图书馆现在空着，如果您需要印什么东西，就是现在了。

lines.en: If I remember correctly, this is...
lines.zh: 如果我没记错的话，这位是……

lines.en: : Makoto...
lines.zh: : Makoto……

lines.en: scene newfirstday14
: Ahh...Y...Yes?
: Oh, sorry. I was just thinking out loud.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我只是不小心说出口了。

lines.en: : You were thinking about...my first name? But you've never called me that. I've always just been {i}Miyamura{/i} to you...
lines.zh: : 您在想……我的名字？可您从来没这么叫过我。在您这儿我一直都只是 {i}Miyamura{/i}……

lines.en: Oh...right. I guess it's kind of weird for me to be addressing my students by their first names.
lines.zh: 哦……对。我这么直呼学生的名字，好像是有点奇怪。

lines.en: I guess it's different with Ami and Ayane since I've known them for a long time, but people like Makoto...
lines.zh: 我想 Ami 和 Ayane 不一样，毕竟我认识她们很久了，但像 Makoto 这样的……

lines.en: Actually, fuck it. If I'm ever going to get to where I want to be with any of these girls, I'm going to have to start chipping away at the walls around them.
lines.zh: 算了，管他呢。如果我真想和这些女孩里的任何一个走到我想要的那一步，就得开始一点一点凿开她们周围的墙。

lines.en: The weakest point I can identify at this point in time is as simple as the way I address them.
lines.zh: 眼下我能找到的最薄弱的一环，简单到只是我该怎么称呼她们。

lines.en: : You don't mind if I use your first name from now on, do you? It'll help me out a lot with the way I plan to handle things from now on.
lines.zh: : 以后我直接叫你的名字，你不介意吧？这对接下来我打算采取的做法会很有帮助。

lines.en: scene newfirstday15
: I-I don't mind at all! You can call me whatever you want!
lines.zh: : 我……我完全不介意！您想叫我什么都行！

lines.en: : But...what do you mean by {i}the way you plan to handle things from now on?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可是……您说{i}接下来打算采取的做法{/i}，是什么意思？

lines.en: : You're not...thinking of changing your teaching strategy months into the school year, are you? Because that sort of change might have a negative impact on-
lines.zh: : 您该不会……想在学年过了一半的时候改教学方针吧？因为这种变动可能会带来负面影——

lines.en: : Let's just head inside and you can see for yourself what I intend to do...okay, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 先进去吧，你亲眼看看我打算怎么做……好吗，Makoto？

lines.en: scene newfirstday16
: Mm! Hearing you call me that is...probably going to take some getting used to. So I sincerely apologize for how moronic I must look right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯！听您这么叫我……大概还需要一点时间适应。所以我真心为自己现在这副蠢样子道歉。

lines.en: : You don't look {i}moronic{/i} at all. In fact, I'd say you're closer to {i}cute{/i} than anything.
lines.zh: : 你一点都不{i}蠢{/i}。事实上，我觉得与其说你蠢，不如说更接近{i}可爱{/i}。

lines.en: scene newfirstday17
: You know it's rude to mess with someone so early in the morning, right?
lines.zh: : 您知道一大早就这么捉弄人很过分吧？

lines.en: : But I suppose we shouldn't be talking any more about that right now...not with the rest of the class still waiting for you.
lines.zh: : 不过我想我们现在不该再聊这个了……毕竟全班还在等您。

lines.en: scene newfirstday16
: I think I'll...head in first, though...and give my face a little time to return to its normal color.
lines.zh: : 我想……我还是先进去吧……顺便给我的脸一点时间恢复成正常的颜色。

lines.en: : Just come on in whenever you're ready, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 您准备好了就进来吧，老师……

lines.en: : We'll all be waiting for you.
lines.zh: : 我们都会等您的。

lines.en: scene black
Makoto darts into the classroom, narrowly avoiding a collision between her shoulder and the door frame, and I am reminded that {i}some{/i} girls might start opening up a little before others.
lines.zh: Makoto 一头冲进教室，肩膀险些撞上门框，而这提醒了我：{i}有些{/i}女孩会比其他人先敞开心扉。

lines.en: For what it's worth, she seems pretty head over heels for me already.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，她看起来已经相当为我神魂颠倒了。

lines.en: But, like she said...there's an entire room full of girls waiting.
lines.zh: 但就像她说的……还有满满一屋子的女孩在等着。

lines.en: All that's left to do now is win over the rest of them...
lines.zh: 现在剩下要做的，就是把其余的人也拿下……

lines.en: scene firstclass1
: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: : 大家早上好。

lines.en: : I, uhh...guess I'll start by saying-
lines.zh: : 我，呃……我想先说——

lines.en: : Wait, aren't we missing someone? I'm pretty sure I'm supposed to have ten students.
lines.zh: : 等等，我们是不是少了一个人？我记得我应该有十个学生。

lines.en: scene firstclass2
: Oh, Yumi's not coming today. She said she's staying at home since she doesn't feel good or something and told me to tell you that.
lines.zh: : 哦，Yumi 今天不来。她说身体不太舒服，所以要待在家里，让我跟您说一声。

lines.en: Already? I feel like it was less than 24 hours ago that Ami was telling me how some of the girls in class like to skip.
lines.zh: 这就开始了？感觉 Ami 跟我讲班上有些女孩爱逃课，还不到 24 小时的事。

lines.en: At least the first culprit is the girl I was most worried about dealing with, though. So maybe this is some sort of blessing in disguise?
lines.zh: 不过至少第一个犯事的是我最头疼的那个女孩。所以也许这也算是某种因祸得福？

lines.en: : Well, thanks. Then, as I was saying-
lines.zh: : 好吧，谢谢。那么，正如我刚才说的——

lines.en: : Wait! Sensei! I have a question.
lines.zh: : 等等！老师！我有个问题。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...okay?
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……你说？

lines.en: : Can I go hang out in the bathroom for the rest of homeroom? One of my favorite idols is appearing on a talk show this morning and I'd be like, {i}super{/i} thankful if I could go watch it.
lines.zh: : 我能不能剩下的班会时间都待在洗手间里？我最喜欢的偶像之一今天早上要上脱口秀，要是能让我去看，我会{i}超级{/i}感激的。

lines.en: : I guess. Just...don't get caught or something? I'm sure you know how this goes.
lines.zh: : 行吧。只是……别被抓到什么的？我相信你懂规矩。

lines.en: scene firstclass2r
: Awesome! Thank you so much, Sensei! You're like, seriously the best teacher ever!
lines.zh: : 太棒了！太谢谢您了，老师！您真是，世界上最棒的老师！

lines.en: scene firstclass3
Chika quickly shoots out of her chair and dashes into the hallway and my morning has already gotten off to a less than ideal start.
lines.zh: Chika 一下子从椅子上弹起来冲进走廊，我这个早晨已经开得不太理想了。

lines.en: But hey, at least I've already begun to curry favor with another one of the girls.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我至少已经开始讨好上另一个女孩了。

lines.en: : Umm...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……老师？

lines.en: And potentially {i}lost{/i} favor with another one in return.
lines.zh: 而代价是可能同时{i}失去了{/i}另一个人的好感。

lines.en: : What's up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: scene firstclass4
: Well...forgive me for my directness, but are you sure that letting her leave was a good idea?
lines.zh: : 那个……请原谅我这么直白，但您确定放她走是个好主意吗？

lines.en: : The last time you did that, she didn't come back until the day was halfway over.
lines.zh: : 上次您这么做，她直到一天过了一半才回来。

lines.en: : I have a hard time believing that a single talk show will take up half of the day. So I'm going to give Chika the benefit of the doubt this time.
lines.zh: : 我很难相信一个脱口秀能占掉半天。所以这次我愿意先相信 Chika 一回。

lines.en: scene firstclass5
: Woah, there! When the heck did you two make it to first-name territory? I ain't ever heard you call her Chika before.
lines.zh: : 哇哦，等等！你们俩什么时候已经好到直呼其名了？我从来没听你叫过她 Chika。

lines.en: : Yes...when, indeed?...
lines.zh: : 是啊……什么时候的事呢……

lines.en: : I'll get to that in a minute. Now, can I please just say what I've been trying to say since I came in here?
lines.zh: : 这个我等会儿再说。现在，能不能让我把从进门起就一直想说的话说完？

lines.en: : Are you sure you don't want to...perhaps run it by me first?
lines.zh: : 您确定不……先跟我对一下吗？

lines.en: : I haven't been briefed on any sort of announcement yet and...as class representative, I believe I have the right to be.
lines.zh: : 我还没听说过任何通知，而且……作为班长，我认为我有权利知道。

lines.en: : No. I will not run it by you, Makoto. Because this is less of an announcement and more of just a...thing that's going to be happening from now on.
lines.zh: : 不。我不会跟你对的，Makoto。因为与其说是通知，不如说这是一件……从今往后都会发生的事。

lines.en: : But...you are {i}announcing{/i} it, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 可是……您不就是在{i}宣布{/i}它吗？

lines.en: : Makoto, just stop talking for a minute.
lines.zh: : Makoto，你先别说话，就一分钟。

lines.en: : Since when is Sensei on a first name basis with everybody?! This is happenin' way too quick!
lines.zh: : 老师什么时候跟所有人都直呼其名了？！这也进展太快了吧！

lines.en: scene firstclass7
: Sensei!
lines.zh: : 老师！

lines.en: Ayane suddenly raises her hand and it quickly becomes apparent to me that I may never be able to actually speak without being interrupted again.
lines.zh: Ayane 突然举起手，我很快就意识到，我大概再也别想完整地说完一句话而不被人打断了。

lines.en: : What, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 又怎么了，Ayane？

lines.en: : Since we're already on a first name basis, can you refer to me as either {i}darling, honey,{/i} or {i}hot stuff{/i} from now on?
lines.zh: : 既然我们都已经直呼其名了，那以后您能不能管我叫{i}亲爱的、宝贝{/i}，或者{i}性感的家伙{/i}？

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。

lines.en: : Not even if I am already prepared to deal with the types of rumors that are sure to spread if you start calling me those things?
lines.zh: : 就算我已经准备好应付那些肯定会传开的流言，也不行吗？只要您开始那么叫我，流言是一定会有的。

lines.en: : One large donation to the school and I can get us out of anything, Sensei. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 给学校捐上一大笔钱，我就能把我们从任何事里捞出来，老师。我说真的。

lines.en: : No, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 不行，Ayane。

lines.en: : In fact, the thing that I've been trying to get to all morning is specifically {i}about{/i} how I'm going to be addressing you all from now on.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我从今早到现在一直想说的，正是{i}关于{/i}我今后要怎么称呼你们所有人。

lines.en: scene firstclass9
: Oh! If we're choosin' our own nicknames, I wanna be Darth Vader! Or just Miku, but with {i}Champion of Justice and Soccer{/i} added on to the end of it.
lines.zh: : 哦！如果是自己挑昵称的话，我要当达斯·维达！要不就叫 Miku，但后面得加上{i}“正义与足球的冠军”{/i}。

lines.en: : That might be a little too long, but I’ll try my best to remember.
lines.zh: : 那个可能有点太长了，不过我尽量记住。

lines.en: scene firstclass10
Ayane puts her hand up yet again.
lines.zh: Ayane 又一次举起了手。

lines.en: : What is it now?
lines.zh: : 这回又是什么？

lines.en: : Nothing really. I just wanted you to look at me again.
lines.zh: : 其实也没什么。我只是想让你再看我一眼。

lines.en: : Hi, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗨，老师。

lines.en: scene firstclass11
: Hi, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 嗨，Ayane……

lines.en: : Now please, if everyone could just stop talking for a minute or two, I'd like to address certain...changes that will be taking place in this classroom from now on.
lines.zh: : 好了，求大家安静一两分钟，我想讲讲从今往后这间教室里要发生的某些……变化。

lines.en: : From this day forward, my teaching strategy is going to be a little different. But I'm sure that my new methods will be-
lines.zh: : 从今天起，我的教学方针会有点不一样。但我相信我的新方法会——

lines.en: scene firstclass12
: Sensei!
lines.zh: : 老师！

lines.en: I already hate this job.
lines.zh: 我已经讨厌这份工作了。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
: I apologize for interrupting, but what do you mean by {i}new methods?{/i} The way you do things now is perfect! Why would you feel the sudden need to change that?
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断您，但您说{i}新方法{/i}是什么意思？您现在的做法已经很完美了！您为什么突然觉得有必要改？

lines.en: : If this has something to do with our grades as a class, I'd be more than happy to offer additional tutoring to anyone who needs it outside of regular school hours.
lines.zh: : 如果这和我们全班的成绩有关，我非常乐意在正常课时之外，给任何需要的人额外辅导。

lines.en: : It has nothing to do with that. It's just a...decision that came to me for no reason whatsoever after school yesterday.
lines.zh: : 跟那个没关系。只是……昨天放学后我毫无理由地做出的一个决定。

lines.en: Just, by {i}no reason whatsoever,{/i} I mean that I suddenly woke up as a teacher despite never even attempting to become one.
lines.zh: 只是，所谓{i}毫无理由{/i}，是指我某天一觉醒来突然就成了老师，而我从来没打算当老师。

lines.en: Of course {i}my{/i} methods will be different from the methods of whoever stood here yesterday. We're entirely different people.
lines.zh: {i}我的{/i}做法当然会和昨天站在这里的那个人不一样。我们是完全不同的两个人。

lines.en: : I'm sure the sudden change might come as a shock to some of you, but I really do think that what I'm suggesting will benefit every one of you a lot more than some...standard education would.
lines.zh: : 我知道这突如其来的改变可能会让你们有些人震惊，但我真的认为，我的提议会比某种……标准教育，让你们每一个人受益更多。

lines.en: : These are supposed to be the best years of your lives.
lines.zh: : 这应该是你们人生中最好的几年。

lines.en: : You're all young and impressionable...and as the person currently responsible for molding all of you, it falls on me to ensure that you {i}enjoy{/i} these years.
lines.zh: : 你们都还年轻，容易受影响……而作为现在负责塑造你们的人，让你们{i}享受{/i}这几年是我的责任。

lines.en: : Let me put it this way- who here besides Makoto is excited to come to school every day?
lines.zh: : 这么说吧——除了 Makoto，在座的还有谁是每天都盼着来学校的？

lines.en: scene firstclass12r
: Okay, who here is excited to come to school every day for reasons that have nothing to do with how long you get to stare at me for?
lines.zh: : 好，那在座的还有谁是每天都盼着来学校的，而且理由跟能盯着我看多久毫无关系的？

lines.en: scene firstclass12r2
: That's what I thought.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: : Sensei, we're a little too old to be converting to the Montessori tactic, don't you think?
lines.zh: : 老师，我们都太大了，不适合改用什么蒙台梭利那一套了吧？

lines.en: : I have literally no idea what that is.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道那是什么。

lines.en: : I'm not suggesting that you all give up on learning and just focus on having fun for the rest of your lives if that's how I'm making it sound.
lines.zh: : 我不是说要你们全都放弃学习、余生只顾着玩——如果我听起来是这个意思的话。

lines.en: : I'm simply saying that, from this point on, I want you to see me as a friend first and foremost...and a teacher second.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，从今往后，我希望你们首先把我当朋友……其次才是老师。

lines.en: : And also that I probably won't assign any work at all anymore and that I trust each one of you to just...independently study during the day while I sleep or something.
lines.zh: : 另外，我大概再也不会布置任何作业了，我相信你们每个人都会自己……自主学习，而我呢，就睡睡觉什么的。

lines.en: scene firstclass13
: Chika walked out on a hell of a class...
lines.zh: : Chika 翘掉了一节厉害的课啊……

lines.en: The two girls in the corner of the room finally decide to join in on the class.
lines.zh: 角落里的两个女孩终于决定加入课堂了。

lines.en: : Umm...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……老师？

lines.en: : Yes? Do you have a problem with this change as well, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 怎么？你对这个改变也有意见吗，Futaba？

lines.en: : N-No! I'd never doubt your methods at all, but...
lines.zh: : 不……不是！我绝不会怀疑您的做法，只是……

lines.en: : I'm not sure if I understand what you mean when you say you want us to...see you as a friend.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白您说的，希望我们……把您当朋友是什么意思。

lines.en: : I just mean that you're going to have a harder time enjoying your lives here if you feel like I'm constantly on some pedestal way out of your reach.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果你们觉得我一直被供在你们够不着的神坛上，那你们就很难享受在这里的生活。

lines.en: : That's precisely what I'm trying to avoid. You don't need another unnecessary authority figure in your lives when that's all you're going to be dealing with for the next...forever.
lines.zh: : 这正是我想避免的。你们的人生里不需要再多一个多余的权威人物——毕竟接下来……永远，你们都得跟这类东西打交道。

lines.en: : So if you can see me as a friend-
lines.zh: : 所以如果你们能把我当朋友——

lines.en: : We...{i}do{/i} need another authority figure, though...
lines.zh: : 可我们……{i}确实{/i}需要一个权威人物啊……

lines.en: scene firstclass15
: {i}Makoto, stop it! Ya have any idea how good this news is for me?! I might actually be able to pass now!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Makoto，别说了！你知道这消息对我有多好吗？！我说不定真能及格了！{/i}

lines.en: : I'm sorry, Miku...and I'm sorry, Sensei. I just can't bring myself to accept or...even understand why you think something like this is a good idea all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Miku……也对不起，老师。我只是没办法接受，甚至……没办法理解您为什么突然觉得这种主意不错。

lines.en: : I didn't expect you to. Like I said, I know this change might be shocking. But if you really trust me...which I know you do, {i}Makoto...{/i}you'll at least try it out.
lines.zh: : 我本来也没指望你接受。就像我说的，我知道这个改变可能让人震惊。但如果你真的信任我……我知道你是信任我的，{i}Makoto……{/i}你至少会试一试。

lines.en: scene firstclass16
: Kay! I'm back. What'd I miss? The air seems kinda off in here all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 好啦！我回来了。我错过什么了？屋里的气氛一下子怪怪的。

lines.en: : Not much. Sensei is just going through a midlife crisis and wants to be friends with all of us now.
lines.zh: : 没什么。老师正在经历中年危机，想跟我们所有人做朋友了。

lines.en: scene firstclass17
: For real? But he doesn't even seem that old.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可他看起来也没那么老啊。

lines.en: : Thanks, Chika. It probably sounds sad, but I really needed to hear that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Chika。听起来可能有点可悲，但我真的需要这句话。

lines.en: scene firstclass18
: No prob, Sensei! You did me a favor earlier, so it's the least I can do to pay you back!
lines.zh: : 小意思，老师！您刚才帮了我一个忙，这点回报是应该的！

lines.en: : Also, does being friends with you mean that you'd like, drive us around and stuff? Cause taking the bus to the mall all the time kinda adds up after a while.
lines.zh: : 还有，跟您做朋友是不是意味着您会开车载我们什么的？因为老是坐公交去商场，久了也是一笔开销。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I don't have a car.
lines.zh: : 不巧，我没有车。

lines.en: Nor do I have any idea how to drive, but I feel like I can safely omit that fact.
lines.zh: 我也不知道该怎么开车，不过我觉着这个事实可以放心地略过不提。

lines.en: : That's fine, I guess. None of my other friends have cars, so it's not like I'm not used to this or anything.
lines.zh: : 那也行吧。我其他朋友也都没车，所以我也不是不习惯这样。

lines.en: : Great. Then-
lines.zh: : 很好。那么——

lines.en: scene firstclass19
: Sensei.
lines.zh: : 老师。

lines.en: : What now?
lines.zh: : 又怎么了？

lines.en: : May {i}I{/i} have a ride after school today?
lines.zh: : 今天放学后能载{i}我{/i}一程吗？

lines.en: : I literally just said that I don't have a car.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚才说了我没有车。

lines.en: : Who said I'm talking about cars?
lines.zh: : 谁说我在说车了？

lines.en: scene firstclass20
: Ayane! Can you {i}not?!{/i} We're still in class even if Sensei is going through a midlife crisis right now!
lines.zh: : Ayane！你能不能{i}别{/i}这样？！就算老师正在经历中年危机，我们现在还在上课呢！

lines.en: : We are, but there aren't any teachers around anymore. Just friends, Ami. And friends can talk about falling in love with friends' relatives, no?
lines.zh: : 是在上课，可这里已经没有老师了。只有朋友，Ami。而朋友之间可以聊“爱上朋友的亲戚”这种事，不是吗？

lines.en: : No!
lines.zh: : 不可以！

lines.en: : Anyway, if anyone has any issues with this, feel free to take it up with me in my office after school.
lines.zh: : 总之，如果谁有意见，放学后欢迎来我的办公室找我谈。

lines.en: : Also, Makoto, if you could remind me where my office is, that would be great.
lines.zh: : 另外，Makoto，如果你能提醒我办公室在哪儿，那就太好了。

lines.en: scene firstclass26
: Oh, don't worry. I already decided to head there the moment you mentioned that's where we need to bring our concerns.
lines.zh: : 哦，别担心。您一提到那是我们提意见的地方，我就已经决定过去了。

lines.en: : At the very least, before these {i}new methods{/i} begin, can we take the quiz I went to the trouble of printing this morning?
lines.zh: : 至少，在这些{i}新方法{/i}开始之前，我们能先做一下我今早特地打印好的那张小测验吗？

lines.en: : Sure, Makoto...You can all take one last quiz before they are gone forever.
lines.zh: : 当然，Makoto……你们就做最后一张小测验吧，之后它们就永远消失了。

lines.en: scene black
I grab the small stack of papers that Makoto left on my desk and begin walking around the class and handing them out.
lines.zh: 我拿起 Makoto 放在我桌上的那小叠纸，开始在教室里走动，把它们发下去。

lines.en: I have no intention of grading any of them once they're completed, but seeing as I may have just erased Makoto's entire reason for living, the least I can do is humor her for now.
lines.zh: 等他们做完，我完全不打算批改，但既然我可能刚刚抹掉了 Makoto 整个人生的意义，至少现在哄哄她我还是做得到的。

lines.en: Class representative aside, though, it seems like everyone else was okay with the idea of a...significantly less formal learning environment.
lines.zh: 不过班长小姐除外，其他人看起来倒是都能接受一个……明显不那么正式的学习环境。

lines.en: Well, everyone else apart from Yumi, who wasn't even here today, and Sana...who has yet to speak so much as a word to me.
lines.zh: 嗯，除了 Yumi——她今天压根没来——还有 Sana……她到现在连一个字都还没跟我说过。

lines.en: Eventually, class comes to an end and Makoto informs me of where my office is before making plans to show up once she's done shredding all of next week's handouts, which she printed way too far in advance.
lines.zh: 课总算上完了，Makoto 告诉我办公室在哪儿，然后说等她把下周的讲义都碎完就过来——那些讲义她提前太久就印好了。

lines.en: scene makoffice0
I lean back in my chair and wait for a small girl with glasses to show up and beg me to be whoever it was she spent the first part of this school year growing closer to.
lines.zh: 我往椅背上一靠，等着那个戴眼镜的小个子女孩出现，求我做回这学年头半段她渐渐亲近起来的那个人。

lines.en: It's a little funny. I figured the reaction she gave me after I called her by her first name meant that she'd be one of the easiest to conquer.
lines.zh: 有点好笑。我还以为，我叫了她名字之后她的反应，意味着她会是最容易攻克的那一类。

lines.en: That thought was a bit short lived, though. Because now, it seems like she's more hesitant than anyone.
lines.zh: 不过这个念头没活多久。因为现在看来，她比谁都更犹豫。

lines.en: So...
lines.zh: 那么……

lines.en: {i}This{/i} is where I'm supposed to be spending my time after school, huh?
lines.zh: {i}这{/i}就是我放学后该待的地方啊？

lines.en: I've already shirked the responsibility of teaching, so I doubt I could get away with shrugging this part of my responsibilities off as well.
lines.zh: 我已经把教课的责任推得一干二净了，所以估计这部分责任我也别想再耸耸肩就糊弄过去。

lines.en: Besides, having a private office could be a good thing.
lines.zh: 再说，有间私人办公室也许是件好事。

lines.en: I have no idea how often the girls in my class will need any {i}counseling,{/i} but an area where we can get to know one another seems like a pretty good idea in my book.
lines.zh: 我不知道班上的女孩会多久需要一次{i}辅导{/i}，但在我看来，有个能让我们互相了解的地方似乎是相当不错的主意。

lines.en: I imagine I'll just be spending most of my time in here sleeping anyway.
lines.zh: 我想我大部分时间大概还是会在这里睡过去。

lines.en: But for now...I must once again figure out how to deal with the handful that is my very own teacher's pet.
lines.zh: 但现在……我得再一次想办法对付我那位棘手的模范生。

lines.en: : Sensei, may I enter?
lines.zh: : 老师，我可以进来吗？

lines.en: : Come on in, Makoto. The door is open.
lines.zh: : 进来吧，Makoto。门开着。

lines.en: scene makoffice1
: Excellent. Because now I can give you an earful about whatever it is that's gotten into you.
lines.zh: : 太好了。因为现在我可要好好说说你到底是中了什么邪。

lines.en: : What are you thinking? Going off and deciding something like that without even {i}consulting{/i} me first?
lines.zh: : 你到底在想什么？连{i}问都不问{/i}我一声，就跑去决定那种事？

lines.en: : With the exception of a few girls, I was under the impression that this year was going extremely well so far.
lines.zh: : 除了少数几个女孩之外，我一直以为今年到目前为止都进展得非常顺利。

lines.en: : So why now? Why would you decide to just...dismantle all that you have built since the school year started?
lines.zh: : 那为什么是现在？你为什么要……把开学以来你亲手建立的一切都拆掉？

lines.en: : I'm not {i}dismantling{/i} anything. I'm just...renovating, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我不是在{i}拆{/i}什么。我只是……大概算是在翻新吧。

lines.en: scene makoffice2
: But we didn't {i}need{/i} renovations! I love the way you teach!
lines.zh: : 可我们根本不{i}需要{/i}翻新！我喜欢你上课的样子！

lines.en: : You know so much about so many things, and the idea of you just abandoning that part of you in exchange for friendship? Well, that's just absurd to me.
lines.zh: : 你懂那么多东西，而要你为了当朋友就把那一部分的自己丢掉？这在我看来简直荒唐。

lines.en: Unfortunately for Makoto, {i}I'm{/i} not the one who abandoned anything. I just woke up somewhere I wasn't meant to be.
lines.zh: 可惜对 Makoto 来说，丢下一切的人并不{i}是我{/i}。我只是醒在了一个本不该有我的地方。

lines.en: She just gets the honor of being the first person who has to suffer because of that.
lines.zh: 她只是有幸成为第一个因此遭殃的人。

lines.en: : Will you give it a shot at least?
lines.zh: : 至少你愿意试一试吗？

lines.en: : If you trust me so much, can't you just go along with it for a little while and see how it goes?
lines.zh: : 如果你这么信任我，就不能先顺着来一阵子、看看情况吗？

lines.en: scene makoffice3
: Are you sure that approaching your job so informally is even allowed?
lines.zh: : 你确定这么不正式地对待自己的工作，真的没问题吗？

lines.en: : What would the other teachers and staff members think if they knew you were going to treat us more like friends than students?
lines.zh: : 如果其他老师和职工知道你打算把我们当朋友而不是学生，他们会怎么想？

lines.en: : I guess we'll just have to wait and see. Besides, it’s not like I’m letting you all run wild. I just think it might be good for us to relax every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，只能走着瞧了。再说了，我又没打算放你们撒野。我只是觉得偶尔放松一下对我们有好处。

lines.en: : Relax?...
: What do you mean, {i}relax?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你说的{i}放松{/i}是什么意思？

lines.en: : Well, what do you do in your free time? Apart from...printing out quizzes and independently studying.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你空闲时间都做些什么？除了……印卷子和自主学习之外。

lines.en: scene makoffice4
: That's...uhh...
Makoto glances off to the side, avoiding eye contact with me and...getting suspiciously embarrassed for someone who was just asked about her hobbies.
lines.zh: Makoto 把视线转向一边，躲开我的目光，而且……对于一个只是被问到爱好的人来说，她可疑地害羞了起来。

lines.en: : That's...a bit of a complicated question...
lines.zh: : 这……是个有点复杂的问题……

lines.en: : It seems pretty normal to me.
lines.zh: : 我倒觉得挺正常的啊。

lines.en: : Well, yes...but my situation is...uhh...
lines.zh: : 嗯，是的……但我的情况是……呃……

lines.en: scene makoffice5
: If I tell you this, can you promise to keep it to yourself?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你，你能保证不外传吗？

lines.en: : Of course. Nothing you say here will ever leave this room.
lines.zh: : 当然。你在这里说的任何话都不会走出这个房间。

lines.en: : Okay...because it would be horrible for me if you were to let this out. So...please keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 好……因为万一你说出去，对我来说就糟了。所以……请你记在心上。

lines.en: Just what kind of seedy shit is this girl up to?
lines.zh: 这丫头到底在搞什么见不得人的勾当？

lines.en: scene makoffice4
: I have...
lines.zh: : 我有……

lines.en: : A part time job...
lines.zh: : 一份兼职……

lines.en: : Oh.
: Is that it?
lines.zh: : 就这个？

lines.en: scene makoffice6
: What do you mean, ‘is that it?!’ Having a part time job is strictly prohibited according to section E of the student handbook!
lines.zh: : “就这个”是什么意思？！根据学生手册 E 部分，打工是严格禁止的！

lines.en: scene makoffice7
: Jeez...You should know this by now, Sensei. It’s one of the most serious infractions of all and can even lead to expulsion in some cases.
lines.zh: : 天哪……老师你现在应该早就知道了啊。这是最严重的违规之一，有些情况下甚至会导致开除。

lines.en: scene makoffice8
: Though...I guess it doesn’t really stop any of the other girls from taking up part time jobs as well.
lines.zh: : 不过……我想这也没能阻止其他女孩去打零工。

lines.en: : Is it really a {i}serious{/i} infraction if so many people are doing the same exact thing?
